quality_notes: UTC observed_at denotes capture/observation, not exchange event time.
History labels and tape clock are retained as displayed. Their timezone was not explicitly shown in these captures; UTC event mapping remains unverified.
1h candle displayed11:00 is before current12:00 bar;4h candle05:00 is before current09:00 bar. No current partial candle used.
Funding_rate in market fields is current predicted rate per displayed interval; historical settled rates and mark prices are separate history rows. Decimal equals displayed percent divided by100.
Open_interest_notional_usdt is value, not quantity. Exact quantity history is stored separately.
Visible book and candle volumes use rounded K/M/B labels; sizes are not exact full-depth liquidity. Quotes, chart and book may update asynchronously.
Only KAIAUSDT, JCTUSDT and STRKUSDT sampled; not full market.
No account, balance, private position, credential or order data included.
